notes.title: Keridwen Demo Translations
notes.notes:
I'm pleased to announce that the Keridwen Demo and Steam page translations are now underway. They will be available in: 

[list]
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Russian
[*] Arabic
[/list]

When the full game is released, it will also be available in these languages.

notes.title: Keridwen Demo Released on Steam
notes.notes:
The Keridwen Demo has now been released on Steam and you can now play the game directly from the Steam client. The full game should be available in Q2 of 2021. 

Wishlist the game to be notified when the full game is released.

Enjoy!
